entrypoint.description: A prompt file path relative to the coworker declaration.

max_turns.description: Maximum Claude turns per process invocation; defaults to 64.

timeout_seconds.description: Total time including provider retries and host calls; defaults to 900 seconds.

context_window_tokens.description: Provider input window used during adapter-owned context preparation. Set this to at most the selected model context window. The adapter conservatively counts UTF-8 bytes as tokens for supplied text and reserves room for instructions, tools, schemas, the exact action request and output; native usage replaces estimates when available.
